name: ThaiData UK MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server providing UK Thai restaurant business intelligence. Query city-level statistics, market overview, opening costs, delivery rates, visa information, and competitive rankings.

tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.description: Get detailed Thai restaurant statistics for a specific UK city

tools.name: get_uk_overview
tools.description: Get overall UK Thai restaurant market statistics

tools.name: compare_cities
tools.description: Compare Thai restaurant statistics between two UK cities

tools.name: get_opening_costs
tools.description: Get estimated cost breakdown for opening a Thai restaurant

tools.name: get_visa_info
tools.description: Get Skilled Worker visa costs and requirements for Thai chefs

tools.name: rank_cities
tools.description: Rank UK cities by restaurant count, hygiene, or density

tools.name: get_market_health
tools.description: Get market health assessment: competition, costs, opportunities, risks

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Search individual Thai restaurants by city, type, or hygiene rating

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find Thai restaurants near a UK postcode with distance sorting
